title: A running total
task: Show on OUT, one after another, the byte at a, then the sum of a and b, then the sum of a, b and c (each modulo 256), then stop. Keep the labels and their DB lines.
starter:
; running-total -- practice exercise (MAVILERA, SAP-1)
; Show a, then a + b, then a + b + c on OUT.
; Hint: OUT copies A and leaves it as it is.
        HLT           ; replace with your code

        ORG 0DH       ; the data at the end of the memory
a:      DB 0
b:      DB 0
c:      DB 0
